title: Advocacy: representing their wishes, not your opinion

cover.title: Patient refuses care. Your move?
cover.kicker: Advocacy means their choice, not yours.

lines.say: They are refusing treatment you know would help. Pause. What do you do?
You support their choice. Advocacy means their wishes, not your opinion.
A competent adult can refuse. Check they understand, and document it.
Worried about safety? Escalate it up the chain. Never work around it.
In Australia, the N M B A Code of Conduct makes culturally safe care a clear duty.
